definitions.clock: performance.now() milliseconds relative to performance.timeOrigin; browser entries use the same origin
definitions.acknowledgment: Zero-delay task after input dispatch; records post-handler requested state including task-queue delay, not a verified paint
definitions.draw: Application draw() entry to completed canvas/DOM submission; includes CPU work, excludes compositor presentation. Attribution deferred until acknowledgment retains its original at timestamp
definitions.presentation: Two consecutive sampled animation frames with no relevant scope motion/busy state; chart scope additionally requires a completed requested draw or explicit terminal result
definitions.frames: Native requestAnimationFrame intervals while recording, including the recorder's own overhead; hidden intervals are labelled
definitions.resources: Browser ResourceTiming/NavigationTiming; cross-origin fields can be zero without Timing-Allow-Origin
definitions.eventTiming: Raw EventTiming entries: threshold 16ms, durations rounded to 8ms, no wheel/pointermove coverage. Missing entries do not establish fast input; not INP or async completion
definitions.nativePaint: Feature-detected paintTime/presentationTime on native paint/long-animation-frame entries; engine-reported frame data, not a physical-display certificate or requested-grid completion
definitions.phases: Async wall-clock spans include yields/waits and can overlap; do not sum them as CPU time
definitions.relatedBudgets: See navigation.v4.json draw/frame/input keys; these differently scoped side-panel diagnostics do not score that benchmark's environment or acceptance
definitions.overhead: Opt-in observer, frame sampling and export overhead are included. No acceptance budgets are changed.
